report: Independently reassessed the current meta.reviews.decisions claim and both complete ordinary annotated tests; the historical decision/outcome schema is obsolete and was not used as an approval. Requirements: completed empty edit lists mean no remaining edits; nonempty edits prevent acceptance; reviewers must account for implementation and test gaps or explicit justified TODO/N/A; status is derived from associated entries and remains visible after accepted deferral; unfinished reviews cannot pass. The ordinary review.rs association covers acceptable, whose output Option must be Some with valid nonblank reviewer/report and an empty edit list, plus current nonempty implementation/test evidence. validate reports unfinished output and requested edits as failures. record accepts well-formed nonempty edit reports without making them acceptable, and load_saved treats unrecorded summaries as output=None. PROMPT explicitly requires all claim aspects, missing coverage edits, and justified prerequisites; this is a human source-adequacy obligation, not a purported automatic semantic proof. inventory preserves implementation status/explanation and derives test status from the enclosing owner module. Captured evidence.rs confirms placeholder_status derives ordinary/TODO/N/A from source module components, excluding crate names. Captured check.rs check_reviews preserves TODO and N/A counts instead of treating accepted deferrals as approved implementation. The test accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence separately constructs both placeholder classes, asserts test and implementation statuses and explanatory backend text, records an explicit deferral report, asserts a valid check with zero approved and the appropriate TODO/N/A count. Its synthetic backend/editorial explanations are fixture evidence exercising status retention, not deferred implementation of this anchor. The test invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review asserts recording without start fails, rejects blank reviewer/report/edit with no output file, rejects stale input without mutating it, verifies the check fails, then records concrete requested edits and checks both exact loaded output equality and continued gate failure. It also asserts the three-field output schema excludes obsolete decision/outcome fields. Fixture helpers were captured and inspected; assertions in these test bodies are substantive and visible. All three current implementation associations are ordinary: review.rs enforces completion and requested-edit acceptance, evidence.rs derives source statuses, and check.rs keeps accepted TODO/N/A visible. Both associated tests are ordinary; no deferred implementation or test gaps exist in this anchor itself. The required permanent associations are present. For this fresh review, compared every current initial fragment with the previously captured evidence: only three meta.reviews.review_diagnostics comments were added in check.rs and a meta.reviews.record_required attribute was added on invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review. The check_reviews point excerpt consequently includes the neighboring diagnostic marker, explaining the changed association metadata. No function behavior, claim text, or assertion body changed. Reassessed all above requirements against the current evidence and found the prior rationale still fully supported. Recaptured fixture helpers and the review specification. Completed report with no requested edits: all claim aspects, three implementation entries, and both complete test entries are accounted for. This is source inspection, with start/read/record commands executed by this reviewer; no tests/build were rerun and no source was edited. Coordinator reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests, and workspace build passing separately; those are not execution claims by this reviewer.
